summary: Iter-11 CRUD: delete/edit/messaging/collateral-actions tested end-to-end. 18/18 new pytest cases pass after fixes. Found and fixed 1 backend serialization bug (push-to-vault leaked Mongo `_id` ObjectId → 500). Cross-role authorization verified (buyer→seller collateral=404, outsider→inquiry=403). Soft-delete filter correctness verified across /inquiries, /deal-rooms, /newsletter. Push-to-vault end-to-end chain verified (encrypted PDF in GridFS, deal_room_files row created, OTS vault.file proof emitted). Frontend smoke test confirms data-testids and trash/edit affordances render across Inquiries, ResearchHub, DealRooms, Newsletter (buyer+seller), Outreach.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 — endpoint returned the doc AFTER `insert_one(doc)` which mutates the dict with Mongo `_id` (ObjectId). FastAPI failed to serialize. FIXED by adding `doc.pop('_id', None)` immediately after insert.

action_items: (Optional) Audit other endpoints that return a doc after `insert_one(doc)` — same ObjectId-leak pattern may exist elsewhere. A quick grep for `await db.*.insert_one(doc)` followed by `return doc` without a `_id` pop will surface candidates.

(Optional) Collateral preview UI is gated on selecting a history item. Consider auto-opening the most recent collateral on page load so the edit/PDF/distribution row is immediately discoverable to users.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (FIXED): /api/collateral/{cid}/push-to-vault leaked Mongo ObjectId in response → 500. Pattern: `await db.deal_room_files.insert_one(doc); ... return doc` — `insert_one` mutates the dict to add `_id`.
Soft-delete helper `_soft_delete` correctly returns 404 when target is already soft-deleted (matched_count==0 due to {$exists: False} guard). Good idempotency.
_inquiry_participant returns the inquiry but the helper is only used for its side-effect in callers like delete_inquiry where the result `inq` isn't reused — the pre-existing F841 lint flag is fine.

Cross-role authorization correctly uses owner-scoped queries (user_id) which produce 404 (not 403) for non-owners on collateral/outreach/newsletter — semantically reasonable (don't leak existence), but worth a product-level decision if uniform 403 is preferred.

Send-to-inquiry only allows the seller to attach their OWN collateral (`coll find_one user_id: user.id`). Buyers cannot attach the seller's collateral into the same thread — acceptable for this iteration.

Push-to-vault calls `notarize_bytes` via `asyncio.create_task` (fire-and-forget). Confirmed proofs are created. If the request lifetime is short, consider awaiting in a background task manager for stronger guarantees.
Newsletter delete: hard for draft/approved, soft for dispatched — matches spec; verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (1-line bugfix at push_collateral_to_vault: doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all data-testids present, list/trash/edit affordances render. Collateral edit/PDF/distribution row is conditionally rendered after selecting a history item (not auto-opened) — verified present in source code.

test_credentials: All 3 (alex/mira/admin) from /app/memory/test_credentials.md work; one ephemeral TEST_outsider_<uuid>@example.com created at runtime for non-participant 403 verification.
seed_data_creation: Test runs create a small amount of TEST_-prefixed research/inquiries/newsletters/outreach/collateral; most are cleaned up by their own delete steps; ephemeral outsider user remains in users collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_crud.py (18 tests, ~2.5min). Key API conventions discovered: research generation is POST /api/research/company (NOT /research/brief); seller listings are GET /api/listings (no /mine suffix); buyer inquiry creation is POST /api/marketplace/{lid}/inquire with {message} (NOT POST /api/inquiries); deal-room files are inside GET /api/deal-rooms/{rid} response (NO separate /files endpoint); newsletter draft is seller-only via /newsletter/draft (buyers get 403); collateral creation needs `target_audience` + `key_points` (NOT `audience`/`highlights`). Push-to-vault now correctly returns the file row JSON without Mongo _id leak.
rca_of_push_to_vault_500: Motor's `insert_one(doc)` mutates the input dict in place to add a Mongo-assigned `_id` (ObjectId). The endpoint then returned that mutated dict directly. FastAPI's `jsonable_encoder` chokes on bson.ObjectId with 'TypeError: ObjectId object is not iterable'. Fix: `doc.pop('_id', None)` immediately after insert (before any further use), consistent with the pattern already used in many other endpoints in this file (e.g., seed_demo_user, marketplace inquire).
